City Measures on the November 3, 2026 Ballot
Measure U - General Obligation Bond Measure for Public Infrastructure and Facilities (2/3 vote)
Measure V - Transactions and Use (Sales) General Tax Measure (majority)
Measure W - Charter Amendment Measure to Amend Multiple Administrative Provisions (majority)
Measure X - Amendments to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (majority)
Measure Y - Initiative Ordinance Creating a Parcel Tax to Fund Arts Institutions and Programs (majority)
Measure Z - Initiative Ordinance Creating a Parcel Tax to Fund a Public Bank (majority)
Measure AA - Initiative Ordinance Sugar-Sweetened Beverage Special Tax (majority)
The City Attorney's Impartial Analysis for each measure provides general information on the effect and operation of each measure.
